speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Sit. The corner is gone. That is the only news the kitchen needed. The boats may be told once.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Once is not enough. Mine reached the real arch. Judith's rested in a reed, and she calls that a song.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: A rest is a kind of winning if the song has ended. I am saying it because he has made it smaller.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: The boats were three. The water was a hand deep. The book came home dry. I am not adding a wall.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: The knife.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: In the belt, and now in the shop. Three hulls, and nothing lost. I have not a fourth boat to confess.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Then the shop has its news. I did not want the arch. Pass the bread.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Eat. We walked. I am not telling the path at a board that has already had a race.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: The hems came home wet, and the cloth came home empty. I have had the three of them since the middle of the afternoon.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Bartholomew was to be told the arch was real.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: He was told nothing of an arch. Thou hadst the step. Let the bread have thee.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: The boats are still on the step. They can have the dark. I am not bringing them in to prove a rest.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave them. A boat that has finished does not need to be told at a table.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: I put the book on the shelf. I am eating. I am not asking.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: A shelf is a shelf. The bread is the nearer thing. Richard, the end of the loaf. You can reach it.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Edmund has his cup, and he is eating, which is the whole of his part tonight. I want the boats off the step before I lock.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The boats can wait for the dark where they are. I am not bringing them in.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: And thou art not bringing the path in either. I have walked enough for one telling, and I am not telling it.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Then the arch is told. I can sit.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: It is told twice. That is the number he needed. The song is still not for the board.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Sit. I have the knife back. That was the length of my curiosity.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: The book stays up. I said I was not asking. I am still not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are both done with it for tonight. The bread is the thing on the board.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: And the cups. I am not leaving this Sunday in the morning's way.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Eat, then. The path is walked, and it is not coming in.
